format: int16 little-endian, metres above the MOLA areoid (fitted, see fit); row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge

fit.method: Top surface of the STL rasterised at 0.2 mm; scale, offset and orientation searched for the highest height correlation with the MOLA MEGDR grid (gale.json); heights = a * z_mm + b by least squares

sites.name: Murray Buttes
sites.src: Scene origin of the Access Mars Murray Buttes terrain fitted to the HiRISE DTM (scripts/preprocess/README.md, murray.json)

mount_sharp.name: Mount Sharp
mount_sharp.src: Highest cell of the HRSC model within 15 km of the MOLA summit of the central mound

source.title: Gale Crater, NASA Science 3D Resources (STL, from HRSC on ESA Mars Express)
source.credit: Data: K. Gwinner, J. Oberst, R. Jaumann, G. Neukum, ESA/DLR/FU Berlin; model: NASA
source.license: NASA 3D Resources, free to use with the credit given on the page

color.format: 8-bit RGB, row 0 = north edge, same bounds as the height grid
color.src: Colour texture of the NASA/JPL-Caltech Mars 3D model (models/mars.glb), sampled over these bounds; about 6 texture pixels per degree
